span.p:
Web Dashboard
[Next.js + React]
4 panel độc lập, strategy authoring,
search, backtest, trade detail, news.
Render DTO; không tính domain.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Go Edge & Market Gateway
[Go workload]
Public REST/WSS, AuthN/AuthZ, quota,
provider WSS/REST, normalize Candle/BBO,
subscription fan-out và internal event ingress.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Python Research API
[Python/FastAPI workload]
Strategy runtime/registry, Agent Platform,
experiment/search orchestration,
news/sentiment orchestration, result queries.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Python Research Worker × N
[Cùng Python image/package]
Claim backtest/agent lease, load immutable Candle+BBO,
Strategy Runtime, LONG/SHORT execution,
persist facts/evidence + transactional outbox.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PostgreSQL
[Source of truth]
market events/snapshots, strategies,
experiments/jobs, trades/evaluations,
news/tags/sentiment, outbox/consumptions
